questions.question: What is the standard geographic definition of 'Road Density'?
options: The number of registered vehicles per kilometer of expressway
The total weight of asphalt used in a district
The width of highway lanes across a state
The length of road per 100 square kilometres of area
questions.explanation: The length of road per 100 sq. km of area is known as density of roads. Distribution of road is not uniform in the country, varying from less than 12 km in Jammu & Kashmir to over 517 km in Kerala.
